{{Top|leg}}
'''Jrahl Ferrin''' was a criminal and the leader of an eponymous gang.

The Jrahl Ferrin gang performed crimes on [[Daslkehnt]] at some point before [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. After a theft, one of the gang members, [[Rei'Kas]], was unhappy with the distribution of the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] and left the gang.
